law_name: Decree of 12 October 2005 on Copyright (published 9 March 2006; WIPO Lex HT008)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 60 years; photographic works 25 years
moral_rights: Moral rights recognized by statute in the Decree
fair_use_exceptions: Free private family-circle performances; short quotations for criticism, polemic or research; short excerpts for news reporting (per thesis on 2005 Decree); works in public places only if not the main subject (Art. 15, per Commons)
registration_required: No (protection arises automatically on creation of an original work fixed in tangible form)
notes: BHDA created by separate decree of 12 Oct 2005 as a public body under the Ministry of Culture. Berne accession 11 Oct 1995, in force 11 Jan 1996 (WIPO notification 172); WTO 30 Jan 1996 per Commons only; WCT/WPPT not found in results
